name: What is the best type of kitchen flooring for homes with pets or children?

mainEntity.name: What is the best type of kitchen flooring for homes with pets or children?

acceptedAnswer.text: For homes with pets or children, durability, scratch resistance, and ease of cleaning are paramount. Luxury Vinyl Plank (LVP) is an excellent choice, offering superior scratch, stain, and water resistance, along with comfort underfoot. Porcelain or ceramic tile is also highly durable, waterproof, and easy to clean, though it can be harder underfoot. Laminate can be a cost-effective option, but ensure it has high-wear layers and is rated for moisture resistance, especially for kitchens. We can help you weigh the pros and cons of each for your household.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury Vinyl Plank (LVP) and porcelain or ceramic tile are highly recommended for homes with pets or children due to their durability, scratch resistance, and ease of cleaning.
